title: Trace what changes when spatial confidence fails
description: Select a runtime condition. Active routes show which measurements, transforms, maps, and remote systems can still support the user-visible result.

nodes.label: Sensor suite
nodes.detail: Produces timestamped observations with calibration identity, exposure, and uncertainty.

nodes.label: Pose and mapping
nodes.detail: Fuses observations into a time-indexed device pose and local map. It must expose tracking quality and relocalization state.

nodes.label: Spatial scene state
nodes.detail: Owns typed coordinate frames, entity versions, permissions, and the transform graph used by application logic.

nodes.label: Renderer
nodes.detail: Builds the visible frame from a pose predicted for presentation time and degrades scene work to preserve the deadline.

nodes.label: Display and input
nodes.detail: Presents world-locked or body-locked content and returns gaze, hand, controller, or voice intent.

nodes.label: Anchor store
nodes.detail: Persists anchor identifiers and application metadata. A restored anchor still needs current localization and confidence.

nodes.label: Semantic inference
nodes.detail: Labels objects or interprets a scene against a versioned capture, pose, map, and model. Stale results must be rejected.

nodes.label: Shared session
nodes.detail: Exchanges anchor correspondences, entity changes, ownership, and conflict metadata without becoming the live pose authority.

scenarios.label: Healthy live frame
scenarios.summary: Timestamped observations become a tracked pose, the scene resolves transforms, and the renderer predicts the pose for presentation time.
scenarios.result: The visible frame remains local and deadline-bound. Remote systems are not required to preserve head tracking or basic interaction.

scenarios.label: Remote semantics
scenarios.summary: The live frame continues locally while a versioned scene capture is classified asynchronously. The response is accepted only if its map, pose, entity, and model versions still apply.
scenarios.result: Late labels may update a future frame; they never stall the current pose-to-display path.

scenarios.label: Tracking lost
scenarios.summary: The runtime cannot currently locate the device in the world frame. A precise-looking world transform would be fabricated.
scenarios.result: Pause placement and high-impact world-locked actions, preserve intent, and show body-locked recovery guidance until localization returns.

scenarios.label: Restore an anchor
scenarios.summary: The application loads a durable anchor identity, but the current sensor map cannot yet establish a confident transform to it.
scenarios.result: Treat the restored anchor as unresolved. Keep content hidden or approximate until relocalization succeeds and expose replacement when the environment changed.

scenarios.label: Shared edit conflict
scenarios.summary: Two participants move the same entity against different anchor correspondences. Transport delivery cannot decide physical authority.
scenarios.result: Resolve ownership and operation order explicitly, preserve both versions for diagnosis, and rebase the winning entity into each participant's local frame.
